summary.name: Flameshot
summary.one_liner: Flameshot is a free, open-source, cross-platform screenshot tool with built-in annotation tools and a command line interface.
use_cases: capture part of the screen and annotate it
blur or pixelate sensitive information in screenshots
bind a keyboard shortcut to take screenshots
add arrows, text, or numbered steps to a screenshot for a tutorial
summary.what_it_does: Flameshot lets you take screenshots by dragging a selection box over the area you want to capture. Before saving, you can annotate the image with arrows, highlighted text, blur or pixelate areas, added text, freehand drawing, rectangular or circular borders, incrementing counter numbers, and solid color boxes. A configuration dialog lets you change the interface color, button selection, keyboard shortcuts, and how images are saved. Several commands are also available in the terminal without launching the GUI, so it can be scripted and bound to key combinations.
notable: Command line interface for scripting and key binds
Built-in annotation tools including blur, pixelate, arrows, and counters
Configurable interface, shortcuts, and save behavior
Installable via many package managers and as portable or installer builds
caveats: Older releases are available separately from the main download
